audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows were wrong in both layers: Level 1 read Skill while whys[0] says Warwick wins the auto exchange, Levels 2-3 read Warwick while whys[1] and whys[2] call them even, Level 6 read Skill while whys[4] hands it to Warwick, and first item / 2+ items read Warwick while whys[5] and whys[6] both say the matchup tips to you.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Warwick / Skill / Skill / Skill / Warwick / Wukong / Wukong and matches the prose row for row. The mirror audit (warwick__wukong) proposed exactly the same six rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 4 set to Warwick, rows 1 and 2 to Skill, rows 5 and 6 to Wukong as matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs, ratings realigned, and the stage explanations rewritten to state why.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic Cyclone line on Warwick's Level 6 row, phases[5].why and phases[6].why were boilerplate that named no timing.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is a 1.5s suppression on 110/90/70s and Riot's data flags it a channel, so it is his Level 6 spike and also the thing your knock-up cancels once you have items. Jaws of the Beast at 8s rank 1 is the sustain your Black Cleaver spike out-paces.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stage names the 1.5s suppression and 110s cooldown; the first-item stage names the 8s Q as what your burst out-paces; the 2+ item stage names Infinite Duress being a cancellable channel.
sources: enemyKit R cd 110/90/70 channel flag text

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] 'Anti-heal his Q sustain', dontsFull[1] 'Fight without anti-heal' and dontsFull[2] 'Brawl him low' all carried bodies copied from other rows. Eternal Hunger's 50%/25% thresholds, Blood Hunt's low-health chase and Primal Howl's 2.5s damage reduction were never stated.
audit.why: Riot's text: Eternal Hunger heals him under 50% health and triples that healing under 25%; Blood Hunt gives move speed toward and attack speed against enemies under 50%, tripled under 25%; Primal Howl grants 2.5 seconds of damage reduction before the fear. Those three are why brawling him low loses and why Grievous Wounds has to be early.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d states the max-health heal on Jaws; dontsFull[1].d states the 25% triple-heal threshold; dontsFull[2].d states Blood Hunt's thresholds; phases[3].why and breakdown.cooldowns carry Primal Howl's 2.5s / 15s and the R and Q numbers.

edits.before: Q-AA poke wins the short exchanges. Identify how Warwick contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Eternal Hunger heals him on every auto once he drops under 50% health, so the Level 1 auto war is his — just farm.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Infinite Duress's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Even stretch: Primal Howl gives 2.5s of damage reduction and then a fear, so start your trade after he burns it, never into it.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Warwick's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5 seconds on 110s at rank 1, and his team collapses on it — do not be the one it lands on.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Infinite Duress's cooldown.
edits.after: Black Cleaver bursts past a Q that heals him only every 8s at rank 1 — force it the moment it completes.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Warwick carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Infinite Duress is a channel, so Cyclone's knock-up cancels it and his dive stops reaching your carries at all.

edits.before: - Warwick Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — His all-in suppress. Decoy it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Infinite Duress: 1.5s suppression on 110s at rank 1, and it is a channel any CC cancels. - Jaws of the Beast: 8s at rank 1, max-health damage that heals him. - Primal Howl: 2.5s damage reduction on 15s.

edits.before: His all-in suppress. Decoy it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 1.5s suppression, 110s at rank 1 — engage right after he spends it.

edits.before: Warwick wastes Infinite Duress — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Jaws of the Beast heals off your max health — Grievous Wounds early.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Under 25% health his passive healing triples — cut it before then.

edits.before: Burning W before the trade starts — the clone IS your defense, and committing without it means eating his full combo.
edits.after: Blood Hunt gives him speed and attack speed under 50% health, tripled under 25% — he catches you, not the other way round.

notes: ownerKit was null in this brief, so no Wukong cooldowns were written — every number is Warwick's from enemyKit. Riot's data does flag Infinite Duress as an interruptible channel, so the page's existing knock-up-cancel claim is supported and I stated it in phases[6].why. Level-chart flips are proposed as one matched full+content group.
